supportLead: Answers below are for HomeCircle 1.3.0 for iPhone. In the app, open Profile and scroll to About to check your version.

whereWeAre.heading: Where we're at
paragraphs: HomeCircle was inspired by LJ's own experience in recovery.
HomeCircle for iPhone is available on the App Store in Australia.
The HomeCircle app works online and offline. Kai, practices, the journal and day count work offline. Current meeting listings and outside links need a connection.

whereGoing.heading: Where HomeCircle is going
items: Coming next: A US version of the HomeCircle website (homecirclerecovery.com). It is not live yet.
